charlie-cs: customer reports structured_json responses causing parse failures. their JS client hits JSON.parse Unexpected token when we forward the model output.

sam-support: can you paste the raw response (redact keys)? which model + streaming on/off? any request-id?

charlie-cs: Model=rwd-infer-small-v1, mode=structured_json, streaming=true. repro request redacted. we captured raw chunks from their proxy — pasted below as-is: 

```json
{"id":"123","path":"C:\users\alice\docs","note":"Line1\nLine2"}
```

charlie-cs: When concatenated the payload sometimes still contains single backslashes in the JSON string (invalid) and sometimes a chunk boundary splits mid-string leaving an unclosed quote, so parse fails. customer sees intermittent failures depending on when streaming chunks arrive.

sam-support: that path is the issue — unescaped backslashes in JSON values are invalid and will break JSON.parse. also literal 
/newline bytes inside string values can get split across chunks.

ben-eng: we've seen two root causes here: 1) models emitting unescaped backslash sequences (eg Windows paths) 2) streaming chunk boundaries splitting tokens. short-term mitigations: set streaming=false for customers, or run a small reserialize step before handing bytes to the client (escape backslashes, replace bare newlines with \n, close open quotes).

ben-eng: long-term: i've opened CR-4321 to add an enforce-escaping pass for mode=structured_json on the server side (we'll JSON-encode the model text and stream the encoded form). aiming for a patch tomorrow.

charlie-cs: customer needs a hotfix today — asked if we can supply a mitigation script and requested we prioritize. request-id=rid_0a1b2c

deploy-bot: started deployment rwd-patch/escape-fix (rollout staging -> prod).

charlie-cs: sent the customer the temporary workaround (disable streaming + reserialize). will monitor. :thumbsup:
